nodes.text: [i]The air is cold and perfectly still. Sparks hang where they flew, each one wrapped in frost. Nothing here has moved in a very long time.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Critic
nodes.text: Overwrought. Overlong. A sword? How original.
[i]The voice comes from a pool of red ink beside the anvil. It is rising.[/i]
[i]Three memories glow on the high ground around the forge: small, and warm, and the voice is very loud. Hold them up to the light.[/i]
